description: Snug main window. C2 note (AC7): capabilities are scoped to the top-level main window ONLY — the sandboxed app iframes must never reach the IPC bridge; the in-shell hard gate asserts unreachability from inside a srcdoc iframe. HTTP scope note: this list is BELT, not policy — the real ceiling is the connected-fetch executor's frozen per-connection allowlist. It is nonetheless kept as tight as the LAN rung allows: `http://` is admitted only for the three RFC-1918 ranges (172.16-31 enumerated, NOT the whole 172/8), plus the single Ollama probe port on loopback and the debug-gate stub port. Blanket `http://localhost:*` and `http://127.0.0.1:*` are deliberately absent — connected-fetch refuses loopback outright, so nothing legitimate needs them. The two loopback entries are single-purpose: 11434 is the Ollama probe (threat-model delta §3.5, an accepted residual outside the connected-fetch guards), and 43120 is DEBUG-ONLY — the in-shell gate's net-stub target (gate/run-gate.mjs SNUG_GATE_STUB_PORT). Tauri bakes capability scopes at build time, so the gate's port cannot be added conditionally at runtime; it is admitted here permanently and is inert in a release build, where the debug-only host remap that points at it does not exist (net-remap.ts). Overriding SNUG_GATE_STUB_PORT to a different port requires adding that port here too.
